Title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - January 14, 2026
Subtitle: [Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - January 14, 2026] Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. View Full Article
Highlights: [Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - January 14, 2026] Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. View Full Article
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  Structures:
  • Towers, Forts, Keeps, and Core
    • Structures now prioritize Summons when there are no remaining Minions.
    • Summons no longer take half damage from Structures.
  • Watch Towers
    • Watch Towers will now reset to neutral after 45 seconds of not being occupied.
  Experience:
  • Experience Globe pickup sound is now also played when killing a Minion that instantly yields Experience.
  User Interface:
  • Pinnacle Rewards have been renamed to Mythic Rewards .

=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Globe of Annihilation [Q]
    • Time window to kill Minions for gaining Annihilation increased from 1.5 to 3 seconds.
    • Additional functionality: Now deals 50% damage to non-Heroes [Undocumented] (excluding Summons) .
    • Reward: Upon reaching 225 Annihilation, Globe of Annihilation no longer deals reduced damage to non-Heroes.
    • [Undocumented] Mythic Reward: After gaining 450 Annihilation, the area of Globe of Annihilation is increased by 15% and it deals 125 additional damage.
  • Summon Demon Warrior [W]
    • Demon Warriors damage increased from [Undocumented] ~~32~~ 35 to 83.
    • Demon Warriors now deal half damage to Heroes.
    • Demon Warriors no longer have a duration.
    • Demon Warriors now lose 26 Health per second.
    • [Undocumented] Demon Warriors duration effectively increased from 10 to 17 seconds.
    • Demon Warriors no longer deal damage to nearby enemies every second.
    • Now has 2 charges.
  • Demon Lieutenant [D]
    • [Undocumented] Demon Lieutenant damage increased from 41 to 103.
    • Demon Lieutenant now deals half damage to Heroes.
    • Demon Lieutenant no longer has a duration.
    • Demon Lieutenant now loses [Undocumented] 28 Health per second.
    • [Undocumented] Demon Lieutenant duration effectively increased from 20 to 21 seconds.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Wrath
      • Rework: Now provides 1 stack for every 2 Basic Attacks hit against a Structure or Hero.
  • Level 7
    • Art of Chaos
      • Extra Annihilation amount reduced from 4 to 2.
    • Bombardment
      • Bombardment's time window reduced from 4 to 3 seconds.
    • Master of Destruction
      • Annihilation granted reduced from 2 to 1.
  • Level 13
    • Brutish Vanguard
      • New functionality: Demon Warriors now Slow the attacked target by 30%.
  • Level 16
    • Hell Rift
      • Damage bonus reduced from 75% to 35%.
  • Level 20
    • Inescapable Annihilation
      • New: Globe of Annihilation has unlimited range.
    • Pride
      • Moved from Level 20 to Baseline Quest.
